mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_learning_roadmap (title, description, status, difficulty, estimated_hours, cover_media_id, sort_order, created_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{difficulty}, #{estimatedHours}, #{coverMediaId}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.sql: r.id, r.title, r.description, r.status, r.difficulty, r.estimated_hours AS estimatedHours, r.cover_media_id AS coverMediaId, r.sort_order AS sortOrder, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_learning_stage s WHERE s.roadmap_id = r.id) AS stageCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_learning_record lr WHERE lr.roadmap_id = r.id) AS learnerCount, r.created_by AS createdBy, creator.username AS createdByName, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, status, difficulty, estimated_hours AS estimatedHours, cover_media_id AS coverMediaId, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_by AS createdBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_learning_roadmap WHERE id = #{roadmapId}

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.description, r.status, r.difficulty, r.estimated_hours AS estimatedHours, r.cover_media_id AS coverMediaId, r.sort_order AS sortOrder, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_learning_stage s WHERE s.roadmap_id = r.id) AS stageCount, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_learning_roadmap r WHERE r.id = #{roadmapId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_learning_roadmap r WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT FROM lab_learning_roadmap r INNER JOIN sys_user creator ON creator.id = r.created_by WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY ${sortColumn} ${sortOrder}, r.id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.description, r.status, r.difficulty, r.estimated_hours AS estimatedHours, r.cover_media_id AS coverMediaId, r.sort_order AS sortOrder, r.created_by AS createdBy, creator.username AS createdByName, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_learning_roadmap r INNER JOIN sys_user creator ON creator.id = r.created_by WHERE r.id = #{roadmapId} AND (#{manager} = TRUE OR r.status = 'PUBLISHED')

SELECT s.id, s.roadmap_id AS roadmapId, s.name, s.description, s.sort_order AS sortOrder, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_learning_unit u WHERE u.stage_id = s.id) AS unitCount, s.create_time AS createTime, s.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_learning_stage s WHERE s.roadmap_id = #{roadmapId} ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC
SELECT FROM lab_learning_roadmap r INNER JOIN sys_user creator ON creator.id = r.created_by WHERE r.id = #{roadmapId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_learning_stage (roadmap_id, name, description, sort_order, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{roadmapId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.roadmap_id AS roadmapId, r.status AS roadmapStatus FROM lab_learning_stage s INNER JOIN lab_learning_roadmap r ON r.id = s.roadmap_id WHERE s.id = #{stageId}

SELECT s.id, s.roadmap_id AS roadmapId, s.name, s.description, s.sort_order AS sortOrder, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_learning_unit u WHERE u.stage_id = s.id) AS unitCount, s.create_time AS createTime, s.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_learning_stage s WHERE s.id = #{stageId}

SELECT s.id, s.roadmap_id AS roadmapId, s.name, s.description, s.sort_order AS sortOrder, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_learning_unit u WHERE u.stage_id = s.id) AS unitCount, s.create_time AS createTime, s.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_learning_stage s WHERE s.roadmap_id = #{roadmapId} ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT u.id, u.stage_id AS stageId, u.title, u.description, u.sort_order AS sortOrder, u.template_id AS templateId, NULL AS templateName, CASE WHEN lr.id IS NOT NULL AND completion.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS completed, u.create_time AS createTime, u.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_learning_unit u INNER JOIN lab_learning_stage s ON s.id = u.stage_id LEFT JOIN lab_learning_record lr ON lr.roadmap_id = s.roadmap_id AND lr.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN lab_learning_unit_completion completion ON completion.unit_id = u.id AND completion.user_id = #{userId} WHERE s.roadmap_id = #{roadmapId} ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC, u.sort_order ASC, u.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_learning_unit (stage_id, title, description, sort_order, template_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{stageId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, NULL, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.stage_id AS stageId, s.roadmap_id AS roadmapId, r.status AS roadmapStatus FROM lab_learning_unit u INNER JOIN lab_learning_stage s ON s.id = u.stage_id INNER JOIN lab_learning_roadmap r ON r.id = s.roadmap_id WHERE u.id = #{unitId}

SELECT u.id, u.stage_id AS stageId, u.title, u.description, u.sort_order AS sortOrder, u.template_id AS templateId, NULL AS templateName, CASE WHEN lr.id IS NOT NULL AND completion.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS completed, u.create_time AS createTime, u.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_learning_unit u INNER JOIN lab_learning_stage s ON s.id = u.stage_id LEFT JOIN lab_learning_record lr ON lr.roadmap_id = s.roadmap_id AND lr.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN lab_learning_unit_completion completion ON completion.unit_id = u.id AND completion.user_id = #{userId} WHERE u.id = #{unitId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO lab_learning_record (roadmap_id, user_id, status, started_at, completed_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{roadmapId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, NULL, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, roadmap_id AS roadmapId, user_id AS userId, status, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_learning_record WHERE roadmap_id = #{roadmapId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.roadmap_id, COUNT(*) AS total_unit_count FROM lab_learning_unit u INNER JOIN lab_learning_stage s ON s.id = u.stage_id GROUP BY s.roadmap_id ) totals ON totals.roadmap_id = lr.roadmap_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.roadmap_id, c.user_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_unit_count FROM lab_learning_unit_completion c INNER JOIN lab_learning_unit u ON u.id = c.unit_id INNER JOIN lab_learning_stage s ON s.id = u.stage_id GROUP BY s.roadmap_id, c.user_id ) completions ON completions.roadmap_id = lr.roadmap_id AND completions.user_id = lr.user_id

COALESCE(completions.completed_unit_count, 0) AS completedUnitCount, COALESCE(totals.total_unit_count, 0) AS totalUnitCount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(totals.total_unit_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(COALESCE(completions.completed_unit_count, 0) * 100.0 / totals.total_unit_count) END AS progress
mapper.select:
SELECT lr.id, lr.roadmap_id AS roadmapId, lr.user_id AS userId, lr.status, lr.started_at AS startedAt, lr.completed_at AS completedAt, , lr.create_time AS createTime, lr.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_learning_record lr
WHERE lr.roadmap_id = #{roadmapId} AND lr.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO lab_learning_unit_completion (unit_id, user_id, completed_at, create_time) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{userId}, #{completedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM lab_learning_unit_completion WHERE unit_id = #{unitId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_learning_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT lr.roadmap_id AS roadmapId, r.title AS roadmapTitle, r.difficulty AS roadmapDifficulty, lr.status, , lr.started_at AS startedAt, lr.completed_at AS completedAt, lr.update_time AS updateTime FROM lab_learning_record lr INNER JOIN lab_learning_roadmap r ON r.id = lr.roadmap_id
WHERE lr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY lr.update_time DESC, lr.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
